findings.F1: The test's main measure is on the side the idea predicts but well short of the bar: mean +0.0121 with t 1.21 on 150 case-days. The tested run already used every fold (A to D) and all 19 coins, so no more data is available to add.
findings.F2: The proportional claim fails at the mild end. In folds B and C, the 10-day short gain over drift by depth quartile of the 30-day fall is +4.6 % in the deepest quartile (raw fall −61 %, t 0.33, 13 days), +12.2 % in q2 (−39 %, t 4.72, 19 days), +4.2 % in q3 (−19 %, t 1.11, 21 days) and −4.6 % in the mildest (−5 %, t −1.35, 20 days). This matches step 5's moderate half (−0.75 %) against its deep half (+2.33 %).
findings.F3: The effect grades more cleanly when the fall is measured against the coin's own daily swing over the same 30 days. By quartile of that scaled fall, the 10-day short gain over drift is +8.3 % (scaled fall −2.09, t 1.39), +5.9 % (−1.33, t 1.82), +4.9 % (−0.77, t 0.94) and −2.4 % (−0.28, t −0.77). The rank correlation is 0.27, against 0.26 for the raw fall.
findings.F4: The raw deepest falls are carried by few days. The deepest raw quartile gains +2.0 % at t 0.33 on 13 days, while large falls in a calm month gain +12.1 % (t 4.22, 14 cases, 9 days). Shallow falls stay near zero whether the month was calm (+0.3 %) or agitated (−1.9 %).
findings.F5: The effect is uneven over time but shows across the coins. By year, the 10-day short gain is +7.7 % (2018, t 2.80), +0.9 % (2019), −0.8 % (2020) and +5.6 % (2021). Over 5 days it is +4.0 % with t 1.75, against +3.4 % with t 1.28 over 10 days and +2.6 % with t 0.59 over 20 days, so the move shows mostly in the first days.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's fall over the past 30 days measured against its own daily swing over those 30 days, the more it keeps falling over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader sizes a short in a flat two-month market by how unusual the month's slide is for that coin, giving little weight to slides that are small against its normal swing.
ideas.name: swing-scaled month slide continues

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's fall over the past 30 days measured against its own daily swing over those 30 days, the more it keeps falling over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader holds a short on an unusual month slide in a flat two-month market for about a week rather than two, where most of the follow-through shows.
ideas.name: scaled slide five-day continuation
